import html # Predefined HTML template for the invitation. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {title}
{title}
Date: {date}
{description}
Notes: {notes}
""" def generate_event_invite(title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title : str The name or title of the event. description : str A comprehensive description of the event (may contain multiple lines and formatting). date : str The scheduled date for the event. notes : str Extra information or instructions provided by the user. Returns ------- str A string containing sanitized HTML for safely displaying the event invitation. Raises ------ TypeError If any of the arguments is not a string. """ # Validate argument types for arg, name in zip((title, description, date, notes), ("title", "description", "date", "notes")): if not isinstance(arg, str): raise TypeError(f"Argument '{name}' must be a string") # Escape all user-provided content to prevent XSS escaped_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) escaped_description = html.escape(description, quote=True) escaped_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) escaped_notes = html.escape(notes, quote=True) # Format the invitation return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( title=escaped_title, description=escaped_description, date=escaped_date, notes=escaped_notes )
